description: This file defines the StaticMenuLinkOverrides class implementing menu link override management using configuration in Drupal. It includes methods for loading, saving, deleting, and encoding menu link overrides, and interacts with Drupal's configuration system.

classes.name: StaticMenuLinkOverrides
classes.description: Implements menu link override management using configuration storage, providing methods to load, save, delete, and encode menu link overrides within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration factory dependency.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object, loading it if not already loaded.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Resets the configuration to force reload from storage.

methods.name: loadOverride
methods.description: Loads a specific menu link override by ID.

methods.name: deleteMultipleOverrides
methods.description: Deletes multiple menu link overrides by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteOverride
methods.description: Deletes a single menu link override by ID.

methods.name: loadMultipleOverrides
methods.description: Loads multiple menu link overrides by their IDs.

methods.name: saveOverride
methods.description: Saves or updates a menu link override with specified definition.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with the configuration.

methods.name: encodeId
methods.description: Encodes a menu plugin ID by replacing dots with double underscores to avoid conflicts in config schema.
